diagnosis: component circularity used connected-component pixel area with contour perimeter and produced impossible values >1
candidate ranking favored longer full-flight intervals, allowing slow same-object reset motion to outrank the fast gravity event

provenance.v6_1_change: development-only correction before fresh validation: bounded contour geometry/solidity/circle-fill/axis-ratio/radius stability; rank fastest ball-like release-from-rest full-travel event instead of longest; gates/repair schedule/|S| unchanged

diagnosis: bounded geometry was fixed, but identity_score remained the first lexicographic ranking term
high-identity slow same-ball traversals still won on takes with 71-frame and 31-frame selected intervals
identity should be an eligibility gate; event ranking must operate on near-full-span candidates and prioritize fastest full travel

provenance.v6_2_change: development-only selector correction: require candidate span >=70% of the maximum eligible ball span in the video, then rank by shortest full-flight duration before timing/shape residuals; emit top-candidate audit; gates/repair schedule/|S| unchanged

v6_2_implementation_error.experimental_interpretation: none; no take produced a selected candidate and this run is classified as software failure, not scientific evidence
v6_2_implementation_error.fix: candidate producer now has total list return contract; selector validates producer return type/candidate schema/finite fields; unexpected exceptions are saved with traceback and force gate false

diagnosis: 70% relative-span rule selected slow reset/handling because reset covered the largest image-space extent
fast gravity candidates on 06,07,09,10 were rejected for smaller local span even though they had much shorter durations
partial gravity fragments must be timed in a global full-drop coordinate rather than interpreted as 100% of the physical drop

provenance.v6_3_change: development-only redesign: estimate full top-bottom pixel envelope from all ball-like motion, use reset only as spatial calibration, keep only downward gravity-direction fragments, fit t=t0+T*sqrt(p_global) in global progress coordinates, and rank by global timing/shape fit; target g remains absent from selection

v6_3_implementation_error.root_cause: V6.3 fragment rejection branches called a helper that existed only in a different legacy function scope; legacy recalibration also referenced diagnostics without declaring it
v6_3_implementation_error.experimental_interpretation: none; all five takes crashed before scientific evaluation
v6_3_implementation_error.fix: module-level _reject helper; explicit diagnostics signatures; rejection-path self-tests; pyflakes in CI and local preflight

diagnosis: V6.3 selector enforced inferred full duration T*fps >= minimum_active_frames
extract() incorrectly re-applied the old rule to observed fragment sample count
the quality gate duplicated the same obsolete assumption via active_frames
